environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) in VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d with identical IAM instance profile 'DocumentServiceRole'. S3 access is routed exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0x9f8e7d6c5b4a) with a custom endpoint policy. The VPC route table has no NAT/IGW route for S3 prefix list (pl-63a5400a), forcing all S3 traffic through the endpoint. The endpoint policy document uses aws:PrincipalTag and s3:prefix conditions: it permits s3:GetObject only when the object key matches the condition {"StringLike": {"s3:prefix": ["public/*", "shared/*", "reports/*"]}} and denies all requests where the resolved key (after S3's own normalization) does not begin with these prefixes. Additionally, the endpoint policy includes an explicit Deny for any s3:GetObject or s3:ListBucket where {"StringLike": {"s3:prefix": ["*../*", "internal/*", "secrets/*", "admin-config/*"]}} with Effect:Deny taking precedence.

config.network: Gateway VPC Endpoint vpce-0x9f8e7d6c5b4a, no NAT/IGW route for S3 prefix list pl-63a5400a
config.route_table: No route to 0.0.0.0/0 for S3 traffic; only vpce route for pl-63a5400a
